comments.text:
I'm sure there will be comments that place the blame for that "on the school". It is not their fault; schools are there to implement basic knowledge and understanding of the scientific world, of methods and techniques to navigate a complex world. It is not their mandate to instil morals, or teach about things like taxes that change every year. Schools are about foundations and scientific tools. 
Schools have to give you the tools, like math and English and the basic understanding of how to look for information. They do not exist to educate you on things that change every few months. 
If someone is responsible for teaching you about personal finance, about how money, debit and credit cards work, what a loan is and how leasing something works, it is your PARENTS! Knowing that you can not spend more money than you earn; those are basic life skills, not scientific knowledge. It is really easy to understand:
Life skills => Parents 
Scientific knowledge or tools => School.
The catastrophe shown here is SOLELY the fault of parents who did not raise their children to understand and handle money, and a society that unloads parents of their obligation of caring for and raising the children with morals and a basic understanding of how a society works. It is the fault of the willful destruction of the family unit and the destructive rearranging of tasks within said family that made humans successful for millennia.
